The turtle has a high-domed, dark brown carapace with lighter orange/yellow margins on the scutes. Its skin is textured and greyish-brown, with prominent scales on the limbs. The head is large relative to the body, with a pointed snout and visible eye. The plastron (underside) appears yellowish-orange. The background consists of blurred human fingers and a dark blue garment.
